description:
Whether the database has the Data API enabled, its address, keys and
    the sites allowed to call it.

    Keys are shown by prefix; the public key also comes with its value (it is
    not a secret: it ships in the site bundle). Secret keys are never returned
    or stored. Enabling the API goes through the CLI; as in
    Supabase, new tables in `public` are then open to the roles and RLS
    decides the rows, so every table needs RLS on. Sign-in and files are
    enabled only by the person in the dashboard.

database.description: The database: name, slug or id. Without it — the organization's only database with the Data API enabled.
database.title: Database
